description: Source code for NettyBlockRpcServer class in Apache Spark, handling network RPC requests related to block management, including opening, uploading, and fetching blocks, as well as handling shuffle data and corruption diagnosis.

classes.name: NettyBlockRpcServer
classes.description: Handles network RPC requests for block operations in Spark, including opening, uploading, and fetching blocks, as well as shuffle data and corruption diagnosis.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Processes incoming RPC messages, handling different request types such as opening blocks, fetching shuffle blocks, uploading blocks, getting local directories, and diagnosing corruption.

methods.name: receiveStream
methods.description: Handles incoming stream data for block uploads, setting up data streaming callbacks.

methods.description: Returns the stream manager instance used by this server.
